messages:
maya: Heads up — planning deploy of rdx-infer v3.2.1 tomorrow 09:30 PST. Non-incident deploy, but includes observability changes (dashboard filters + a couple alert threshold tweaks). Who can own smoke checks and rollback?

devon: I can be primary on rollback/rollback script ready. Will be oncall that window. :thumbsup:

ben: I will own dashboards and traces during the rollout. Can you list the exact panels we'll touch?

maya: Thanks. Changes are: 1) rename inference_latency -> inference_latency_p90 (split out), 2) add model_variant label to the trace/span tags, 3) reduce alert on tail-latency from 3000ms -> 2000ms for the dedicated pool only.

priya: lowering tail alert sounds risky without a smoke plan. Can we gate it to the dedicated cluster only and add a temporary maintenance alert silence?

ben: Agreed. I'll scope the alert change to resource_group = "dedicated-prod" and add a 30m auto-silence during rollout.

maya: Perfect. Smoke checklist (quick):
```
# smoke steps
1) deploy to canary (1 replica) in us-west2
2) run smoke generator: curl -X POST https://canary.rdx/api/generate -d @sample-prompt.json
3) verify p90 < 700ms, errors < 1% for 5m
4) check traces for model_variant tag present
5) promote to full canary (10% traffic), re-run checks
```

devon: I'm adding rollback runbook pointer: https://internal/runbooks/rdx-deploy-rollback v3.2.1. Rollback command is in the runbook, but TL;DR is `kubectl set image deploy/rdx-infer rdx=rdx-infer:3.2.0 --namespace=prod` and then scale back canaries.

ben: Dashboard diffs I'll apply: add new panel p90 latency by model_variant, update legend, keep old panel hidden for 48h. I'll post screenshots to this thread before finalizing.

priya: Also suggest we add a short eval set run (10 prompts) against canary to catch regressions in output. I can run it and post diffs.

maya: Good call. Priya will run evals at canary and post A/B diffs. Ben will update dashboards and set alert scope and temporary silence. Devon owns rollback/monitoring. Ops-bot: please schedule a deploy reminder 15m before and trigger the alert silence at deploy start.

ops-bot: Scheduled: deploy reminder for rdx-infer v3.2.1 at 09:15 PST tomorrow. Auto-silence (30m) on alert "tail_latency_dedicated" will be applied at 09:30 PST.

ben: Posting dashboard preview in 10m.

priya: I'll prep the eval artifacts and sample-prompt.json now and link them here once uploaded.

maya: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, ping here. Otherwise let's treat this as a normal preflight and meet in #eng-platform at T+10m for smoke readout. :rocket:
